source.heading: The source

docMeta.dd: Exercises in Articulation, The Dayspring, March 1874, p. 39

Wikiquote’s Misattributed section transcribes the two lines and names The Dayspring (March 1874), p. 39. Original scan was not independently examined. Official King site dates IT to September 1986, overriding Wikiquote’s apparent 1985 error.

source.excerpt:
He thrusts his fists against the posts,
And still insists he sees the ghosts.
trail: The sourced Wikiquote entry transcribes the old exercise; it is our anchor, not an independently inspected scan. Tongue-twister history ↗

source.rightsNote: The checked provenance reference transcribes this wording from a specified 1874 publication, before 1931. That historical rhyme is public domain in the United States; this is not a rights claim over King’s novel.
